llm_response.reason: The website presents itself as a financial advisory firm, providing detailed descriptions of professional services, a long operational history (since 1989), and properly structured sections. The domain is over 25 years old and registered using a common registrar with privacy protection. No typical scam indicators (unrealistic promises, urgency tactics, up-front fees, fake endorsements, spoofing, or ambiguous information) are present. While an SSL certificate note was flagged, this is not enough to classify the website as a scam. All evidence supports its legitimacy.
